subject: [PATCH v2 01/10] mm/madvise: name the shared LRU PMD callback

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch renames a shared LRU page-walk callback in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module to better reflect its purpose and functionality. The callback, previously named after its PTE implementation, is now called madvise_lru_pmd_entry(). This change does not introduce any functional changes but improves code clarity by aligning the name with its registration as a PMD callback. The patch is part of a larger series of changes to the mm/madvise module.
